claim_scope: Comprehensive successor research evidence for every critical Tau logical-ABI path introduced by PR #534. It binds the original asset-transfer and lane-journal ADT specifications plus the asset-registry/transfer and command-occurrence tau-value table specifications to the exact locked IDNI/tau-lang source and the corrected single-job cvc5 + Boost/log + Tau build rail. This packet is intentionally broad so historical append-only packets remain immutable replay records without being selected for current changed paths whose shared build helper evolved. All executable claims remain bounded, research-only, and authority-free.
failure_modes: a rejected asset-transfer result changes its abstract state root or carries effects
POST_STATE_RESOURCE_BOUND_EXCEEDED escapes the closed typed rejection algebra
whole or nested ADT arguments do not flatten to the intended predicate arity
the saturating journal cursor wraps from maximum to zero
an absent asset key contributes a transfer row
a same-step asset registration self-authorizes a transfer despite the prior-state gate
a reused occurrence id survives freshness difference
a changed-payload replay under the same occurrence id mutates the command table
an invalid table contribution changes prior logical state
the replay uses a mutable Tau source name rather than the exact lock
an earlier REPL answer masks a final wrong verdict
the hosted build OOMs by auto-parallelizing cvc5 or Boost
Tau configuration fails because pinned Boost/log was not bootstrapped
bounded logical-table evidence is overstated as physical storage, consensus, or settlement authority

aaa.reason: The packet pins all current Tau sources and tests in one selection unit. Replays arrange ADT result boundaries, journal saturation, present/missing asset keys, prior-state activation, unseen/seen occurrence ids, and changed-payload replay; act through Tau's decision and temporal execution paths on an exact source checkout; and assert exact theorem verdicts, explicit false controls, and terminal structured stream states.

reject_is_noop.reason: The ADT result algebra requires every reject to preserve its abstract root and carry no effects. Both table contracts reduce invalid contributions to lattice zero, and join with zero preserves prior logical state.

nonclaims: This evidence grants no production, settlement, publication, verifier, migration, release, or value-moving authority.
bv[8]/bv[16] roots, identifiers and amounts are bounded abstract tags; this is not production u128/u256 arithmetic.
The tau-value tables are logical row sets, not proofs of SQL semantics, physical persistence, indexing, crash consistency, concurrency control, or distributed storage durability.
The asset table proves bounded key existence only; enabled status, policy membership, authorization, balances, fees, signatures, encoding, hashes, and proof verification remain separate.
The occurrence replay table assumes the host probe is canonically bound to the occurrence id inside the command row; production canonical encoding/hash binding remains separate.
A successful exact-source build is research replayability evidence, not Tau Net consensus or deployment attestation.
This evidence does not close O-008, does not close any whole-value-movement gate, and does not make the pre-existing P22 formal-cycle packet current.
